I replied to Hollis in the thread. The only deadline on record is the one Pree posted in #central-team on 14 October: the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August.

I also told him two things:
- **The date has already passed this year.** Pree never replied when I asked whether she meant next year or a different date.
- **I had nothing to check it against.** I couldn't find any Tansley Parcel account files.

I suggested he confirm the date with Pree before putting it in the account sheet.
